Agent Memory & Context Compaction](1agentmemorycontextcompaction) [2\. SchemaConstrained Decoding & Grammar Engines](2schemaconstraineddecodinggrammarengines) [3\. SWEbench & Automated AST Code Editing](3swebenchautomatedastcodeediting) [4\. MCP (Model Context Protocol) Hardening](4mcpmodelcontextprotocolhardening) [5\. Sandboxing & Isolation (Docker, gVisor, Firecracker)](5sandboxingisolationdockergvisorfirecracker) [6\. Benchmarks & Real Production Metrics](6benchmarksrealproductionmetrics) [Contributing & Community](contributingcommunity) ⚡ Architectural Manifesto Modern LLMs with 128k–1M token context windows create a dangerous illusion of infinite memory. In long autonomous agent runs (40+ tool turns), attention weights irreversibly dilute across the KV cache (Lost in the Middle). 1. Never summarize failed tool calls: Raw error tracebacks must remain verbatim until fixed, or the agent cycles infinitely. 2. Grammarconstrained decoding over prompt validation: Enforce JSON Schemas via CFG logits masks prior to softmax (99.97% validity vs 92% with prompt prompting). 3. Lock your compaction routines: Parallel tool invocations in async loops trigger race conditions and doublecompaction without asyncio.Lock. 1\. Agent Memory & Context Compaction _Threetier rolling compaction architecture:_ [ LAYER 1: Pinned Invariants ] ─── System contract, safety boundaries, tools (Raw, 0% drop) │ [ LAYER 2: Compacted Ledger ] ─── Deduplicated facts of completed successful tool cycles │ [ LAYER 3: Hot Raw Tail ] ─── Last 46 turns (Fresh local state + unresolved stacktraces) Reference Implementations: RollingMemoryCompactor (Python/Go): Automatic deduplication of idempotent file reads (head, cat) into SHA256 pointers. Episodic KV Cache Offloading: Pruning intermediate layer KV tokens for background context. 2\. SchemaConstrained Decoding & Grammar Engines [xgrammar](https://github.com/mlcai/xgrammar): Fast GPUaccelerated grammarguided decoding for vLLM and SGLang. [outlines](https://github.com/dottxtai/outlines): Structured text generation via finitestate machine (FSM) index over model vocabulary. [guidance](https://github.com/guidanceai/guidance): Interleaved generation and control logic with tokenlevel regex constraints. Production Example (vLLM + xgrammar): from vllm import LLM, SamplingParams from vllm.sampling_params import GuidedDecodingParams schema = { "type": "object", "properties": { "tool": {"enum": ["patch_ast", "execute_test", "commit_fix"]}, "file_path": {"type": "string", "pattern": r"^[\w\\./]+\.[az]+$"}, "patch_content": {"type": "string"} }, "required": ["tool", "file_path", "patch_content"], "additionalProperties": False } params = SamplingParams( temperature=0.1, max_tokens=1024, guided_decoding=GuidedDecodingParams(json=schema) ) 3\. SWEbench & Automated AST Code Editing [Treesitter](https://treesitter.github.io/treesitter/): Incremental concrete syntax tree parsing for ASTaware diffing. [SWEbench](https://www.swebench.com/): Benchmark for evaluating LLMs on resolving realworld GitHub issues. Syntactic Rollback Guards: Reverting invalid patches at parsetime before invoking compilers. 4\. MCP (Model Context Protocol) Hardening Prompt Injection Defense in Tools: Strict sanitization of dynamic tool definitions from untrusted MCP servers. Zombie Process Reaper: Automatic cleanup of stdio subprocesses exceeding idle TTL. Concurrency Rate Limiting: Nonblocking select token buckets to prevent LLM retry stamp
items.author: snowdensay
items.descZh: 这篇文章系统性地整理了AI智能体在生产环境下的基础设施设计规范，涵盖了内存管理、约束解码、代码编辑和协议安全等多个关键领域。其核心理念在于，尽管现代LLM拥有超长上下文窗口，但在长周期自主运行中，注意力权重会因KV缓存稀释而出现“中间失忆”问题，因此需要一套严谨的工程化方案来保障可靠性。文章详细阐述了三层滚动内存压缩架构，通过固定关键信息、去重压缩历史记录和保留最新交互尾迹来优化内存使用。亮点在于引入了语法约束解码技术，通过在模型输出前应用CFG对数its掩码，将输出有效性从提示工程的92%提升至99.97%，从而大幅减少了结构化输出的错误。此外，还集成了Tree-sitter用于AST感知的代码编辑、SWEbench作为评测基准，并对MCP协议提出了加固建议，包括防范提示注入和限制并发速率等。这些技术特别适用于需要长时间自主执行复杂任务、频繁调用工具并产生结构化输出的AI智能体系统。
items.quote: 通过提示验证进行语法约束解码：在 softmax 之前通过 CFG logits 掩码强制执行 JSON 模式（有效性为 99.97%，而使用提示提示则为 92%）。

[Try it](tryit) · [The guide](/elitan/northstack/blob/main/crates/northstack/GUIDE.md) · [Updating](updating) · [Contributing](workingonnorthstack) northstack is an opensource, fullstack web framework: a Rust backend (axum, sqlx), a React frontend with Next.jsstyle folder routing, and SQLite. Typed end to end. Types are generated from your SQLite schema: the tables become Rust types, your Rust procedures become a typed TypeScript client (like tRPC), and every SQL query is checked at compile time. Rename a column and just check shows every query and page it breaks. One binary. The server, the frontend and the database engine build into one file you copy to a server, like PocketBase. No database server to run. Built for coding agents. Claude Code, Codex and Cursor write and maintain northstack apps: there's one obvious way to do everything, and the compiler catches mistakes before you ever see them. A feature in three files 1\. The table. A SQL migration. server/migrations/20261201_projects.sql CREATE TABLE projects ( id UUID PRIMARY KEY NOT NULL, name TEXT NOT NULL ); 2\. The API. Plain Rust functions. The Project type is generated from the table above. // server/src/features/projects/procedures.rs pub async fn list(ctx: Ctx<AppState, _input: ()) RpcResult<Vec<Project { Ok(db::list(&ctx.state.db).await?) } pub async fn create(ctx: Ctx<AppState, input: NewProject) RpcResult<Project { northstack::ensure(input.name.is_empty(), "name is required"); Ok(db::insert(&ctx.state.db, &input.name).await?) } 3\. The page. The folder is the URL, like Next.js. The API is already typed in React. // web/app/projects/page.tsx /projects import { api } from "northstack"; export default function Projects() { const projects = api.projects.list.useQuery(null); const create = api.projects.create.useMutation(); return ( < <h1Projects</h1 <button onClick={() = create.mutate({ name: "Apollo" })}Add Apollo</button <ul {projects.map((p) = <li key={p.id}{p.name}</li)} </ul </ ); } That's it: no REST routes, no fetch calls, no API types to write by hand. After create succeeds, the list refreshes on its own. Mistakes don't get far Types flow from the database to the screen, so a typo or a changed column is caught by just check in a few seconds. items.author: elitan
items.descZh: Northstack 是一款创新的开源全栈 Web 框架，它将 Rust 后端（基于 axum 和 sqlx）、React 前端（采用类似 Next.js 的文件夹式路由）以及 SQLite 数据库引擎整合并编译为单个二进制文件，无需运行外部数据库服务，部署流程极其简捷。其核心亮点在于实现了端到端的全类型安全，数据库表结构会自动生成 Rust 类型和 TypeScript 客户端（类似 tRPC），所有 SQL 查询均在编译期经过严格检查。在开发效率上，框架展现了极高的自动化水平，开发者只需通过 SQL 迁移、Rust 函数和 React 页面三个文件即可快速构建功能，且重命名数据库列时，运行 `just check` 即可秒级定位所有受影响的页面和查询。该框架专为 AI 编码智能体（如 Claude Code、Cursor 等）优化，提供了清晰明确的开发规范，借助编译器在编译阶段拦截潜在错误。它非常适合追求极致类型安全、快速原型开发以及深度集成 AI 编程助手的中小型全栈项目。
items.quote: 类型从数据库流向屏幕，因此拼写错误或列的变更只需几秒钟的检查就能发现。
items.titleZh: 展示：Northstack – 将 Rust、React 和 SQLite 融入单一二进制文件，实现端到端类型安全

Jenkinsfiles. One static binary, no JVM. Written in Rust on a [treesitter](https://treesitter.github.io/) grammar. $ groovyfmt check Jenkinsfile test/groovy/BaseTest.groovy ... would reformat 27 of 27 files $ groovyfmt reformatted 27 of 27 files $ groovyfmt lint test/groovy/BaseTest.groovy:2:1: UnusedImport: The [mock.CurrentBuild] import is never referenced (fixable) ... 10 violations in 27 files (UnnecessaryGroovyImport 1, UnusedImport 9) Run on [jenkinsinfra/pipelinelibrary](https://github.com/jenkinsinfra/pipelinelibrary). Safe. Formatting changes whitespace only by default. Output is reparsed and tokencompared with the input, and a file is left untouched if anything else would change. Files that don't parse are never touched. Fast. Formats the 635file [spock](https://github.com/spockframework/spock) repo in 0.19 s. npmgroovylint didn't finish in 15 minutes ([benchmark](https://github.com/costajohnt/groovyfmt/blob/main/docs/coverage.mdspeed)). Broad. 99.6% of a 23,766file corpus (grailscore, gradle, spock, nextflow, Jenkins pipelines) parses ([coverage](https://github.com/costajohnt/groovyfmt/blob/main/docs/coverage.md)). Install brew install costajohnt/tap/groovyfmt macOS, Linux npm install savedev groovyfmt or: npx groovyfmt check cargo install locked groovyfmt Rust 1.90+ and a C compiler Prebuilt binaries for Linux (static musl), macOS and Windows, each with a .sha256, are on every [release](https://github.com/costajohnt/groovyfmt/releases). See also [Windows](https://github.com/costajohnt/groovyfmt/blob/main/docs/windows.md). Not published yet: the Gradle plugin on the Gradle Plugin Portal (it works from a checkout) and a Docker image. items.author: costajohnt
items.descZh: groovyfmt 是一个用 Rust 和 tree-sitter 语法编写的快速格式化和 lint 工具，专门针对 Groovy、Gradle 构建脚本和 Jenkinsfiles。它提供格式化、检查和 lint 功能，无需 JVM，只有一个静态二进制文件。亮点包括速度极快，格式化 635 个文件的 Spock 仓库只需 0.19 秒，而 npmgroovylint 在 15 分钟内都没完成；覆盖率高达 99.6% 的 23,766 个文件语料库可以解析；安全方面，格式化默认只改变空白，输出会被重新解析并与输入比较，确保只有空白变化时才修改文件。适用场景包括 Jenkins 流水线、Gradle 构建脚本和 Groovy 代码的格式化和 lint。
items.quote: Formats the 635file spock repo in 0.19 s.
